## Bessent Says Hormuz Deal Could Come Soon; U.S. Equity Futures Rally

A confirmed Hormuz reopening would ease one of the active geopolitical cost-of-capital overhangs on growth equities; the conditional framing means headline risk persists — any reversal of Bessent's signal could snap back the futures gains and pressure risk assets.

- Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated a Hormuz Strait deal 'could come soon,' triggering broad futures gains in the S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq.
- Language is conditional — no confirmed deal; this is a forward signal, not a concluded agreement.
- Caterpillar and Palantir were specifically named as stocks in focus alongside the macro move.
- Risk-off unwind dynamic: Hormuz reopening would reduce energy supply disruption risk premium.
